items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: I took Don’s chair in the Dave Pell Octet.

ctx.x: I was so blown away. And I never heard a trumpet player yet, not a jazz player. Well I had heard Harry James on a 78 but not realizing you know. But the first jazz trumpet player I heard was Don Fagerquist with the Les Brown band. And I went uh — what the heck is that? You know? And then I started buying all the Les Brown albums so I could listen to Don. And then years later when he was with the Dave Pell Octet I bought all of those. And then after Don had passed away, Dave called me up. I took Don’s chair in the…
That’s great. Well after we’re done here I want you to go back and see if those three records are still in your 3,000 LP collection.
